verdict.rationale: Adyen's own POS marketing page claims the product simplifies 'financial reconciliation', and its docs mention managing transactions in the Customer Area and configuring payouts per merchant account. This is a thin, first-party-only mention with no documented itemized reports. Missing for 10: documented itemized transaction reports, fee breakdown reports, settlement/payout matching against daily takings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can reconcile daily takings against payouts with itemized transaction and fee reports

citations.quote: Simplify everything from terminal management to financial reconciliation.
Lets you manage your payment terminals and transactions from our unified Customer Area.
This means you have the option to [change how you get paid](https://docs.adyen.com/account/getting-paid#change-how-you-get-paid) for each of your merchant accounts.
